sloka: एवं ब्रुवति काकुत्स्थे मुनिर्वाक्यमथाब्रवीत् ।शृणु राम यथावृत्तं पुरा त्रेतायुगे युगे ।। ७.७६.५१ ॥
transliteration: evaṁ bruvati kākutsthe munirvākyamathābravīt ।śṛṇu rāma yathāvṛttaṁ purā tretāyuge yuge ।। 7.76.51 ॥

translations.english: When Rama, the descendant of Kakutstha, spoke thus, the sage then replied, "Listen, O Rama, to what happened formerly in the Treta Yuga."
